title: The Summer Pantry

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: My pantry is full to the brim with summer things! But I can never remember what's in which jar.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Will you write a label for each one? Listen to each word, and put its sounds in order.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.
feedback.all_good: Every jar is labelled. My pantry has never been so tidy!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Thank you, friend. What a fortnight: hay, milk, jam and eggs! The farm couldn't have done without you.

journal_line: I labelled the jars in Mrs. Hannah's summer pantry.
